name: @anthropic-ai/claude-code-deps
//: Only packages the extracted tree actually resolves at runtime belong here.
ws is imported by claude-code itself; string-width, wrap-ansi, slice-ansi,
semver and yaml back Bun API shims in files/bun-polyfill.cjs. wrap-ansi is
called through a tab guard there: it expands tabs where Bun does not, and
the renderer's style offsets are computed against the unexpanded string.
ts-morph was dropped on 2026-08-28. It had been declared since the port's
early days, but no release from 2.1.110 through 2.1.251 imports it, and it
is absent from upstream's own dependency list. Its only trace is a skill
script template (source-kit.mjs-*.txt) that does import { Project } from
'ts-morph' -- but that template runs from the user's project directory, so
it resolves against that project's node_modules, never ours, and the
wrapper sets no NODE_PATH. Removing it also drops @ts-morph/common,
path-browserify, tinyglobby, fdir and picomatch: 15.4 MB installed.
Restore it if a future release genuinely imports ts-morph, or if a skill
turns out to run those templates with our node_modules on the path.
